mio-06-c2.quote: United States Attorney Jacqueline C. Romero and the Justice Department today announced the ongoing seizure of 32 internet domains used in Russian government-directed foreign malign influence campaigns colloquially referred to as “Doppelganger,”
mio-06-c2.claim: On 4 September 2024 the US Justice Department announced the seizure of 32 internet domains used by Doppelganger, a campaign it said was run by the Russian companies Social Design Agency, Structura and ANO Dialog under the direction of the Russian Presidential Administration, in particular First Deputy Chief of Staff Sergei Kiriyenko.

mio-06-c3.text: Dara Kerr (2024). Meta shutters tool used to fight disinformation, despite outcry. NPR, via OPB.
mio-06-c3.quote: Meta is shutting down its CrowdTangle tool, despite researchers petitioning the company to keep it going through January 2025.
mio-06-c3.claim: Meta shut down CrowdTangle, its tool for tracking public content on Facebook and Instagram, on 14 August 2024, less than three months before the US election, despite petitions from researchers to keep it running through January 2025.

mio-06-c3.text: Shannon Bond (2024). A major disinformation research team's future is uncertain after political attacks. NPR, via OPB.
mio-06-c3.quote: In recent weeks, the university did not renew the contract of Renée DiResta, the group's research manager, along with other staffers.
mio-06-c3.claim: After lawsuits, subpoenas and millions of dollars in legal fees, Stanford did not renew the contract of the observatory's research manager, Renée DiResta, in 2024, and the partnership said it would not work on the 2024 or future elections.

mio-06-c3.text: Supreme Court of the United States (2024). Murthy v. Missouri, No. 23-411. Supreme Court of the United States.
mio-06-c3.quote: At this stage, neither the individual nor the state plaintiffs have established standing to seek an injunction against any defendant.
mio-06-c3.claim: ruled 6–3 that the states and individuals suing federal officials over pressure on platforms lacked standing, so it never reached the merits.

mio-06-c3.text: European Commission (2025). Commission adopts delegated act on data access under the Digital Services Act. Shaping Europe's digital future.
mio-06-c3.quote: On 2 July 2025, the Commission published a delegated act outlining rules granting access to data for qualified researchers under the Digital Services Act (DSA).
mio-06-c3.claim: On 2 July 2025 the European Commission published a delegated act under the Digital Services Act letting vetted researchers apply for the internal data of very large online platforms and search engines to study systemic risks in the EU, with the first researchers due to be vetted from October.

mio-07-c1.text: Josh A. Goldstein, Girish Sastry, Micah Musser, Renee DiResta, Matthew Gentzel, Katerina Sedova (2023). Generative Language Models and Automated Influence Operations: Emerging Threats and Potential Mitigations. arXiv.
mio-07-c1.quote: provide a framework for stages of the language model-to-influence operations pipeline that mitigations could target (model construction, model access, content dissemination, and belief formation)
mio-07-c1.claim: They also mapped where defences could bite, at four stages: model construction, model access, content dissemination and belief formation.

mio-07-c1.text: Josh A. Goldstein, Jason Chao, Shelby Grossman, Alex Stamos, Michael Tomz (2024). How persuasive is AI-generated propaganda?. PNAS Nexus.
mio-07-c1.quote: GPT-3-generated propaganda was also highly persuasive, and 43.5% of respondents who read a GPT-3-generated article agreed or strongly agreed with the thesis statement, compared to 24.4% in the control (a 19.1 percentage point increase).
mio-07-c1.claim: Reading the original propaganda raised agreement to 47.4%; reading GPT-3's version raised it to 43.5%.

mio-07-c1.text: Josh A. Goldstein, Jason Chao, Shelby Grossman, Alex Stamos, Michael Tomz (2024). How persuasive is AI-generated propaganda?. PNAS Nexus.
mio-07-c1.quote: Our findings suggest that propagandists could use AI to create convincing content with limited effort.
mio-07-c1.claim: The authors concluded that propagandists could use AI to create convincing content with limited effort.

mio-07-c2.text: Al Jazeera (2024). OpenAI says it disrupted Chinese, Russian, Israeli influence campaigns. Al Jazeera.
mio-07-c2.quote: Despite the efforts to influence the public discourse, the operations “do not appear to have benefited from meaningfully increased audience engagement or reach as a result of our services,” the firm said.
mio-07-c2.claim: Yet OpenAI found the operations did not appear to have benefited from meaningfully increased audience engagement or reach as a result.

mio-07-c2.text: Karissa Bell (2024). Meta says AI-generated content was less than 1 percent of election misinformation. Engadget.
mio-07-c2.quote: "During the election period in the major elections listed above, ratings on AI content related to elections, politics and social topics represented less than 1% of all fact-checked misinformation," the company shared in a blog post
mio-07-c2.claim: In December 2024 Meta reported that, across the year's major elections, ratings on AI content related to elections, politics and social topics represented less than 1% of all fact-checked misinformation.

mio-07-c2.text: Felix M. Simon, Sacha Altay, Hugo Mercier (2023). Misinformation reloaded? Fears about the impact of generative AI on misinformation are overblown. Harvard Kennedy School (HKS) Misinformation Review.
mio-07-c2.quote: Instead, we argue here that the consumption of misinformation is mostly limited by demand and not by supply.
mio-07-c2.claim: In October 2023 Felix Simon, Sacha Altay and Hugo Mercier argued that fears of an AI misinformation wave were overblown, because the consumption of misinformation is limited mostly by demand, not supply.

mio-07-c2.text: Shannon Bond (2024). A political consultant faces charges and fines for Biden deepfake robocalls. NPR.
mio-07-c2.quote: The Federal Communications Commission proposed a $6 million fine against Steve Kramer, who has admitted to commissioning the fake call sent to thousands of people in New Hampshire on the eve of the state's January primary.
mio-07-c2.claim: The political consultant behind them, Steve Kramer, faced a proposed US$6 million fine from the Federal Communications Commission and was indicted on 13 felony counts of voter suppression and 13 misdemeanour counts of impersonating a candidate.

mio-07-c3.text: Oxford Internet Institute (2025). Oxford researchers reveal how conversational AI can change political opinions. Oxford Internet Institute, University of Oxford.
mio-07-c3.quote: Targeted post-training, including supervised fine-tuning and reward modelling, can increase persuasiveness by up to 51%, while specific prompting strategies can boost persuasion by up to 27%.
mio-07-c3.claim: Post-training raised persuasiveness by up to 51% and prompting strategies by up to 27%, so small, widely available models could be tuned to match large proprietary ones.

mio-07-c3.text: Oxford Internet Institute (2025). Oxford researchers reveal how conversational AI can change political opinions. Oxford Internet Institute, University of Oxford.
mio-07-c3.quote: The study reveals a troubling trade-off: the more persuasive a model is, the less accurate its information tends to be.
mio-07-c3.claim: The most persuasive outputs were packed with fact-checkable claims, and there was a troubling trade-off: the more persuasive a model, the less accurate its information tended to be.
